entities.summary: Chittaranjan Das, popularly called Deshbandhu, was a Bengali freedom fighter, political activist and lawyer during the Indian Independence Movement and mentor of Subhas Chandra Bose. He was the founder-leader of the Swaraj Party in undivided Bengal during the period of British Colonial rule in India. His name is abbreviated as C. R. Das. He was closely associated with a number of literary societies and wrote poems, apart from numerous articles and essays. Chittaranjan Das was a poets & playwrights from Bikrampur (1870-11-05, Bikrampur–1925-06-16). A moderately significant entity in the historical record.

historicalSignificance.significanceNarrative: As a key figure in the Indian Independence Movement and mentor to Subhas Chandra Bose, Chittaranjan Das played a significant role in shaping regional politics during British Colonial rule. His leadership of the Swaraj Party in undivided Bengal had lasting consequences for the region's freedom struggle.
